verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents first-party tracing and observability: real-time monitoring of agents and workflows with metrics, logs and traces, plus token-usage and execution-time tracking, and AMP offers real-time execution monitoring. The evidence never shows that each individual LLM call and tool invocation is captured as a span and browsable in a trace UI. missing for 10: explicit per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation trace capture, documentation of the trace viewer UI itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: Tracing & Observability: Monitor and track your AI agents and workflows in real-time, including metrics, logs, and traces.
Monitor, evaluate, and optimize your CrewAI agents with comprehensive observability tools
Performance Monitoring: Track agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption
Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure and monitor their execution in real-time.
